title: Factorized CAVIA task context with held-out factor combinations
hypothesis: A shared CAVIA context vector addressed by task-factor and role-factor coordinates can recover held-out combinations with lower actual task-state bytes than independent contexts; Mirror-specific value requires beating direct-angle and additive factorized CAVIA controls.
physical_object: One shared 16-input, 8-context linear task model and context basis
logical_multiplicity: Sixteen task functions from a 4x4 factor product, with four task combinations held out

task_worlds.training_pairs: all remaining pairs; every factor value appears in training
task_worlds.aligned_context: one shared context vector transformed by factor-indexed block-Givens rotations R(alpha_i)R(beta_j)
task_worlds.private_interaction_world: aligned context plus pair-specific residual with fixed relative amplitude 0.25

controls: independent CAVIA context fitted from each task's support, including held-out task supports
factorized Mirror rotation context fitted on 12 training combinations
native direct-angle CAVIA with the same factor coordinates
native additive factorized CAVIA context u_i+v_j fitted on training combinations

development.selection_metric: held-out aligned nRMSE, private-interaction nRMSE, complete serialized payload bytes, task-state bytes, context/factor fit operations and wall time

paid_objects: shared base predictor and context basis
independent task contexts or factor context seed and angle codes

success_gate: Both development seeds on aligned tasks: held-out nRMSE <=0.05, >=20% improvement over shared/no-context, and task-state bytes <=75% of independent CAVIA; additionally beat native direct-angle and additive factorized CAVIA at comparable bytes/compute for a Mirror-specific result.
failure_gate: Any aligned quality/storage miss, exact direct-angle output-and-state alias, or native additive factorized CAVIA matching quality at equal/lower bytes and compute.
boundaries: Synthetic linear mechanism only; no meta-training
Factor indices are available metadata and charged; no task-free routing claim
Four held-out diagonal combinations preserve all factor levels in training
Private interaction residual measures where factor-specific private context is needed
Fresh seeds remain sealed after any development gate miss or native alias
